relationships.subject: aromadendrin
relationships.evidence_quote: The finding of this study demonstrates the protective effect of aromadendrin against MIA-induced OA in the rats via alteration of TLR4/MyD88/NF-κB, HO-1/Nrf2, and Bcl-2/Caspase-3 pathways.

relationships.subject: aromadendrin
relationships.evidence_quote: Aromadendrin significantly altered the mRNA expression of HO-1, Nrf<sub>2</sub>, Bax, Bcl-2, caspase-3, TLR4, MyD88, and NF-κB.

key_findings: Oral aromadendrin protected against MIA-induced osteoarthritis in rats, altering inflammatory (COX-2, PGE2, MMPs), oxidative and apoptotic markers via TLR4/MyD88/NF-κB, HO-1/Nrf2 and Bcl-2/caspase-3 signaling.
